spec.name: Aerial Survey Aircraft
spec.raw_description: High-aspect-ratio aerial survey aircraft, 1,200 km range, AR 13.5 slender wing, 7075-T6 aluminium spar.

defaulted_fields.crew_count: Inferred by Gemini (gemini-3.5-flash): aerial survey aircraft
defaulted_fields.stall_speed_ms: Assumed 28 m/s (~54 kt), inside the 61 kt CS-23 single-engine stall limit
defaulted_fields.taper_ratio: Assumed 0.45, near-elliptical lift for an unswept wing (Raymer 2ed, Ch. 4 (p. 56))
defaulted_fields.thickness_to_chord: Assumed 0.15 root aerofoil thickness (Raymer 2ed, Fig. 4.14 (p. 47): value read from chart trend, not a printed number)

defaulted_fields.bsfc_kg_per_j: Assumed 6.8e-8 kg/J (0.40 lb/hp/h) piston cruise SFC
defaulted_fields.limit_load_factor: Assumed +3.8 g limit, CS-23 normal category

assumptions: crew_count: Inferred by Gemini (gemini-3.5-flash): aerial survey aircraft
cruise_speed_ms: Assumed 60 m/s (~117 kt) touring cruise
cruise_altitude_m: Assumed 2,500 m (~8,200 ft) cruise altitude
stall_speed_ms: Assumed 28 m/s (~54 kt), inside the 61 kt CS-23 single-engine stall limit
taper_ratio: Assumed 0.45, near-elliptical lift for an unswept wing (Raymer 2ed, Ch. 4 (p. 56))
thickness_to_chord: Assumed 0.15 root aerofoil thickness (Raymer 2ed, Fig. 4.14 (p. 47): value read from chart trend, not a printed number)
cl_max: Assumed 1.6 with simple flaps deployed
ld_max: Assumed 11, typical fixed-gear GA (Raymer 2ed, Fig. 3.6 (p. 22): value estimated from chart, not a printed number)
bsfc_kg_per_j: Assumed 6.8e-8 kg/J (0.40 lb/hp/h) piston cruise SFC
limit_load_factor: Assumed +3.8 g limit, CS-23 normal category
ultimate_factor: Assumed 1.5 ultimate factor of safety (CS 23.303)
wing_position: Assumed high wing (Cessna 172-style touring baseline)
